body.purpose: Persian RTL guidance and recovery text.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Reserved for the next confirmed operational action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:42px; padding:0 13px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:#b86e27; color:#fffaf4; font-family:Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#8d511c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8d511c; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Operational Panel
components.description: The calm structural surface for workspace and state content.
components.html:
فضای میزها

وضعیت زنده از سرویس دریافت می‌شود.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:28px; border:1px solid #d9c9b5; border-radius:14px; background:#fffdf9; color:#2d261f; font-family:Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin:10px 0 0; color:#655747; line-height:1.9; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Text-and-icon semantic status; never color only.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; min-height:30px; align-items:center; padding:4px 9px; border:1px solid #9dcaae; border-radius:999px; background:#e0f1e5; color:#28734b; font:700 12px Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; }

components.name: Operational Input
components.description: Light input surface with an explicit amber focus boundary.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height:46px; padding:0 13px; border:1px solid #c9b197; border-radius:10px; background:#fffaf4; color:#2d261f; font:14px Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#8d511c; outline:2px solid rgba(184,110,39,.22); outline-offset:1px; }

narrative.overview: A light operational workspace for busy Persian RTL cafe service. Cream surfaces, dark readable text, and restrained amber keep status and the next action clear without becoming a marketing treatment.
keyCharacteristics: Light warm surfaces with high-contrast operational information.
Amber reserved for action and identity.
Semantic status uses text and icons as well as color.

rules.name: The Amber Reserve Rule
rules.body: Amber identifies the action that moves work forward; it is not a general-purpose decoration or a default status color.

dos: Do keep operational text dark against light warm surfaces.
Do use semantic state colors with text and icons.
donts: Don't reintroduce a dark page canvas for POS surfaces.
Don't use glassmorphism, oversized rounded cards, hero sections, or decorative motion.
